forgexSolutions.name: Revenue Leak Check
forgexSolutions.description: One-week audit ($500 fixed price, credited toward any fix ordered within 30 days) measuring how many calls, web form leads, and written estimates slip through after 4:30 PM or during busy dispatch hours.
forgexSolutions.problem: Potential uncaptured calls, delayed web form responses, and unfollowed written estimates.
forgexSolutions.whyNotExistingSoftware: Before buying or reconfiguring software, a quick diagnostic establishes whether a real revenue leak exists and whether the company's current back-office tools already have unused automation features.

forgexSolutions.name: Lead-to-job pipeline
forgexSolutions.description: Automated pipeline ($1,800 setup plus $149/month) that captures Squarespace form submissions and missed calls within two minutes, sends an instant SMS/email acknowledgment, and creates a tracked follow-up task in their field-service software.
forgexSolutions.problem: Delayed response to web form leads and after-hours/overflow calls outside the 8:00 AM–4:30 PM weekday window.
forgexSolutions.whyNotExistingSoftware: Squarespace forms do not natively push structured job leads into field-service software with instant SMS reply and persistent callback reminders without custom integration.

forgexSolutions.name: Owner's Monday numbers
forgexSolutions.description: Weekly one-page summary ($1,200 setup plus $99/month) consolidating booked revenue, close rate on written estimates, average ticket, cost per booked job by lead source, and accounts receivable across operations.
forgexSolutions.problem: Fragmented visibility into ad spend performance, estimate close rates, and receivables across residential and commercial work.
forgexSolutions.whyNotExistingSoftware: Standard field-service software, accounting software, and ad accounts rarely combine cost-per-booked-job and receivables into a single cross-system weekly digest without custom data integration.

feasibility.explanation: Integrating Squarespace form submissions and call/SMS workflows is straightforward, but overall technical feasibility depends on what field-service management and accounting software Crofts Electric uses internally, which is not observable on the public website.

aiDelivery.explanation: Deterministic workflow automation handles lead capture, instant SMS/email replies, and weekly metrics aggregation reliably, while AI agents can assist with classifying incoming project descriptions (e.g., panel upgrade vs. commercial fit-out vs. property management work order) and drafting initial replies.

humanReview: All written electrical estimates, pricing, and scope assessments must be reviewed and approved by a licensed electrician.
Code-compliance determinations, load calculations (such as EV chargers, standby generators, and sub-panels), and commercial bidding require direct human oversight.
Non-routine customer inquiries or emergency electrical safety issues must be routed immediately to qualified staff rather than handled by automated replies.

risks.description: Automated SMS or phone follow-ups to leads must comply with TCPA consent requirements and state telemarketing rules.
An automated assistant or intake workflow must never give DIY electrical troubleshooting advice or imply that an electrical hazard is safe to ignore.
Customer contact details, property addresses, and access instructions from property managers or Realtors must be transmitted and stored securely with minimal access.

commercial.implementationCost: Revenue Leak Check: $500 fixed price (credited in full toward any fix ordered within 30 days); Lead-to-job pipeline: $1,800 setup plus $149/month; Owner's Monday numbers: $1,200 setup plus $99/month.
assumptions: The website states percentage discounts (15% off initial service call labor for new customers; 10% off for repeat customers, seniors, first responders, and active military) but publishes no dollar prices or service call fees, so illustrative commercial value cannot be calculated under ForgeX's evidence rules.

discovery.outreachSubject: Question about lead & estimate follow-up at Crofts Electric
discovery.outreachBody:
Hi [redacted],

I was looking at Crofts Electric's Boise website and noticed you handle everything from residential panel upgrades and EV chargers to property management and commercial fit-outs, with office hours running Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM.

At ForgeX, we work with owner-led electrical and home-service contractors on fixed-price workflow automations—such as routing web form leads and after-hours inquiries into your field-service software with an instant reply, or tracking open written estimates and ad-spend ROI in a one-page Monday summary.

Before recommending anything, we always check whether your existing software already covers what you need. If you don't already have automated lead intake and estimate follow-up in place, we also offer a 1-week Revenue Leak Check ($500 fixed price, credited in full toward any fix you order within 30 days) to measure whether any calls, leads, or written estimates are slipping through.

Would you be open to a brief 10-minute call to see if this is relevant to your Boise and Lexington operations?

Best regards,

[Founder Name]
[Founder Title], ForgeX
[ForgeX Phone Number]
[ForgeX Physical Postal Address]

If you prefer not to receive future emails from us, simply reply with "unsubscribe" or use [Opt-Out Link] and we will remove you right away.

Workforce qualification policy (journeyman and master electricians only).
Lead intake mechanism (Squarespace form and phone call), service categories, and Google tag script evidence.

limitations: The website does not disclose the total employee headcount of Crofts Electric (whether it falls within the 10–75 staff target range).
Internal back-office software (such as field-service management, dispatching, or accounting systems) cannot be observed from the public website.
The website publishes percentage discounts (10% and 15%) but no dollar prices or service call rates, preventing a quantitative commercial value calculation.
The linked page https://www.croftselectricboise.com/trusted-experts-boise-electricians-lexington-electricians returned HTTP 404 (not found).
No business email address or physical street address is published on the pages read.

qualification.rationale: Crofts Electric is an owner-led electrical contractor ([redacted]) operating in Boise, ID and Lexington, KY with evidence of paid ad tracking (gtag AW-805112476), a clear business phone channel ([redacted]), weekday-only stated hours (Monday–Friday, 8am–4:30pm), and a standard Squarespace contact form with no visible online booking or automated lead capture on the site. However, staff headcount (10–75 employees) is unconfirmed on the website, and operational problems such as missed after-hours calls or unfollowed written estimates remain hypotheses rather than confirmed facts on the site.
